newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka dips on quieter Latvian market.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka dips on quieter Latvian market.

text.p: Trade on the Latvian stock exchange was quieter on Thursday and bank Unibanka slipped, the bourse said.
Overall market trade came to just 65,917 lats, of which Unibanka made up 20,136 lats. Its share price slipped to 2.30 lats from 2.41 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet was also quiet on turnover of 3,100 lats and was again unchanged at one lat.
The secondary list was led by Daugavpils chain again on business of 19,466 lats and it slipped by one santime to 1.15 lats.
Kaija fish cannery was second most active on trade of 10,444 lats and it rose to 1.24 lats from 1.20 lats.
The rest of the market was very quiet.
The Mangali shipyard rose to 39 santimes from 38 santimes and turned over 1,198 lats.
